agent_notes: Government-directory verification succeeded: all four supplied NIRF 2025 category pages contain University of Allahabad with PRAYAGRAJ and Uttar Pradesh.

Official identity and campus were verified from the University of Allahabad homepage, history page and contact page; the verified address is Senate House Campus, University Road, Old Katra, Prayagraj (Allahabad), Uttar Pradesh - 211002.

The managed proxy produced the exact self-signed certificate-chain error during the initial normal TLS NIRF requests; curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the expected official NIRF and University of Allahabad hostnames.

The official Academics > Courses page provides a 144-name programme table. Current 2026 official admissions pages additionally show B.A.B.Ed., B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) and Five Year Integrated Course in Yoga and Meditation, which are not present as exact rows in that central catalogue. These entries were retained from the official admissions pages, but the catalogue is therefore marked partial and the institution is manual_review.
The central official pages did not explicitly verify programme duration, eligibility or mode for these entries, so those fields are null or marked not specified rather than inferred.
Only the University of Allahabad Prayagraj campus and its official catalogue were used; similarly named affiliated colleges listed on the site were not imported.
